Penrose Hale Chartered Accountants
165 Grosvenor Court
Cheltenham
Gloucestershire
GL52 5GY
Telephone: 0113 496 0164
penrosehale.co.uk

Job ref: PH/25/3514
25 Jun 2025

Strictly private and confidential
Mr Bill Peters
52 Belmont Parade
Tooting
London
E7 5LB

Dear Mr Peters,

Re: Providing bookkeeping and VAT return services each quarter

We are pleased to confirm our engagement. This letter sets out the basis on which we will be providing bookkeeping and VAT return services each quarter.

Dominic Stevenson, Director, will have overall responsibility for your matter. Day-to-day work will be carried out by John Stewart, Associate, who you can contact on (01923) 498062 or john.stewart@penrosehale.co.uk. If John is unavailable, please ask for Mr. Stevenson.

Our fees
Our charges are based on the time spent. The current hourly rates are £220.00 for a partner and £205.00 for other fee earners, plus VAT. We estimate the total cost at £2,300 to £4,250 plus VAT and disbursements.
Please pay £700.00 on account to our client account: sort code 77-24-63, account 02577787, quoting reference PH/25/3514. We will never change our bank details by email.

Proof of identity
Under the Money Laundering Regulations 2017 we must verify your identity. Please bring your passport or photocard driving licence and a utility bill dated within the last three months.

If you are unhappy
If you are unhappy with our service, please contact Dominic Stevenson. You may also complain to the Chartered Institute of Taxation.

Limitation of liability
Our liability to you for any loss arising from this engagement is limited to £1,750,000, unless the law does not allow such a limit. 

Storage of documents
We will keep your file for at least 15 years after the matter ends, after which it may be destroyed without further notice. We store documents electronically and may not keep paper originals. 

Professional indemnity insurance
Our insurer is Travelers and the cover applies throughout the UK. We hold professional indemnity insurance with Travelers. Details of the cover are available on request. 

Data protection
Our privacy notice explains how we use and protect your information. We will use your personal data only to provide our services and to meet our legal obligations under the Data Protection Act 2018. 

Our terms of business are enclosed and form part of this letter. Please sign and return the enclosed copy so that we can start work.

Yours faithfully,
Dominic Stevenson
Partner
Penrose Hale Chartered Accountants

------------------------------
I confirm that I have read and agree to the terms set out in this letter.
Signed: [signature]
Name: BILL PETERS
Date: ________
